reasoning_content:
The minio-init service uses entrypoint shell commands with `mc alias set`. The bitnami minio-client entrypoint is a script. But compose defines `entrypoint: ["/bin/sh","-c", ...]`, which overrides the image entrypoint. Also the working user is 1001. mc needs HOME. Let's check that mc runs in that container with entrypoint override as user 1001. HOME=/ maybe. Let's just start the stack.

Also minio healthcheck: `curl -fsS http://localhost:9000/minio/health/live` — bitnami minio has curl at /usr/bin/curl, and PATH includes /usr/bin. Good.

Let's start the stack.

action.command: cd /workspace && timeout 590 docker compose --env-file .env up -d --wait 2>&1 | tail -40; echo "exit=${PIPESTATUS[0]}"
